items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Anna Mae Wong, remember her, some movie star and a gang of American movie stars, so we pop in there.

ctx.x: She was there as a guest. Anna Mae Wong, remember her, some movie star and a gang of American movie stars, so we pop in there. I will never forget it. We were all dressed in white because it was in the summer, you know, in July, we had on white uniforms and special made, white special made shoes, all sharp, so this guy that's married to the Queen now, he grabbed Duke right away and sit him down at the piano stool and they start playing -- see, he play piano and start playing and Duke, wait a minute -- he say, 'I…
He padlocked Duke right away. I go over to the drums and a little cat's sitting down on the floor and so then we played, played and played and before we started playing there
